outcome: composite adverse outcome (resting pressure <40 mmHg, squeezing pressure <100 mmHg, internal and/or external anal sphincter defects)
cohort: The study participants were 349 women who experienced obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) at Cork University Maternity Hospital.
finding: Functional outcomes and manometry results were similar between obese and non-obese women following OASI, but non-obese women had higher rates of anatomical defects in the external anal sphincter.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in the mode of delivery between obese and non-obese women.
